notes.title: Demo 0.8.21 Update — Lots of New Cards & QoL Improvements
notes.content:
[p]It’s been a while since I last wrote an update log—I’ve quietly pushed some changes behind the scenes.
But that’s not really fair to everyone, so here we go.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🧟 Fracture[/h3][p]A large batch of new cards has been added. Some still don’t have their final artwork yet, but I wanted to let everyone try them out.[/p][p]Many of these cards focus on synergy and combo mechanics, which should help address some of the clunky feedback players gave before.[/p][p]Some of the new interactions might even feel a bit overpowered… but hey, let’s see what happens once players break the game.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🩸 Sanguinar[/h3][p]The Ranger also received some new cards, and a few old ones were removed.[/p][p]The new cards mostly revolve around the evasion mechanic. For example:[/p][list][*][p][b]Shadowstep[/b] doubles your Evasion.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Afterimage[/b] restores lost Evasion.[/p][/*][/list][p]The focus here is on [i]dynamics[/i]. While stacking defense endlessly is fun and relaxing, I wanted players to experience a constant ebb and flow—like a rollercoaster.[/p][p]Evasion is Sanguinar’s signature defensive tool, and these cards are designed to reflect that.[/p][p]Also, if you noticed, a few Sanguinar's cards were “borrowed” by Fracture… (they supposedly volunteered).[/p][hr][/hr][h3]✨ QoL Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Numeric hotkeys now let you select cards quickly.[/p][/*][*][p]Quick-play support: cards will queue and resolve automatically after being played.[/p][/*][*][p]Hovering over a card gradually shows its keyword explanations.[/p][/*][*][p]Clicking on a Splitter on the field lets you inspect its feeding pile.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo 0.8.1 Update — A Wave of Balance Changes & QoL Improvements
notes.content:
[h3]⚔️ Evasion Mechanic Rework[/h3][p]The previous Evasion system had some depth, but the concept of [i]Agility[/i] often caused confusion.
This time I’ve reworked evasion once again, making it easier to understand while keeping its unique depth:[/p][p][b]Evasion:[/b]
When attacked, reduce final damage by the number of Evasion stacks, then halve the Evasion stacks.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🃏 Evasion-Related Card Reworks[/h3][list][*][p][b]Roll and Evade[/b]: Discard 1 card, gain 8 Evasion.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Daring Step[/b]: Gain 6 Evasion. If you lose HP from an attack this turn, lose all Dodge.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Spinback[/b]: Gain the amount of Evasion you have previously lost this battle. Shuffle. Deplete.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Shadow Cloak[/b]: Gain 4 Evasion whenever attacked.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Scarlet Phantom[/b]: Gain 2 Evasion whenever you gain Bleed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Phantom Sword[/b]: Deal damage equal to Evasion stacks, then halve Evasion stacks. Repeat until all Evasion is gone. Then restore all Evasion.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🩸 Blood Ranger Card Adjustments[/h3][list][*][p][b]Cleave[/b]: Now has [i]Instant[/i].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Incurable Curse[/b]: Target’s Bleed will never decrease (until battle ends). Now has [i]Deplete[/i].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bloodburst[/b]: Becomes 0-cost when upgraded.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Crimson Thorn[/b]: Duration 3 → 5.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Scab[/b]: Healing 5 → 8.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Pierce the Heart[/b]: Damage 12 → 16, Bleed 12 → 16.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🧟 Flesh Aberration Card Adjustments[/h3][list][*][p][b]Red Eyes[/b] → [b]Show-off[/b]: Deal 2 attack damage. For each other creature on the field, attack 1 additional time.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Big Mouth[/b]: Now increases number of attacks when fed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Peacekeeper[/b]: Gains 99 Taunt when summoned.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Meat Mountain[/b]: Taunt intent removed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sapling[/b]: HP growth per turn 5 → 10.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Locked Target[/b]: Cost 1 → 0, now has [i]Exhaust[/i].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Grimace Assault[/b]: Damage 10 → 14.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Slide Tackle[/b]: Damage 7 → 8.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Feast[/b]: Cost 3(2) → 2(1).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Flesh Bomb[/b]: Cost 2 → 1.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Beast Stance[/b]: Strength 3 → 4.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Berserk[/b]: Negative effect changed to -3 max temporary HP.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Stand Forward[/b]: Taunt 2(3) → 4(6).[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🛡️ Taunt & Multi-Hit Attack Interaction[/h3][list][*][p]Attacks targeting random enemies are now also affected by Taunt.[/p][/*][*][p]Multi-hit attacks from monsters and splitters are now treated as random attacks.[/p][list][*][p]Example: The Castle Archer’s “Multi-Shot 4×6” will no longer keep shooting a dead splitter, but instead redirect to the next target.[/p][/*][*][p]On the flip side, when your splitter uses “5×8,” it won’t waste all hits on a single enemy, but will spread them across all enemies.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🕯️ Other Adjustments[/h3][list][*][p][b]Foul Cards[/b]: Can no longer be drawn actively, but 1 is automatically drawn at the start of each turn.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Parasite Adjustments[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Bone Sprout: Negative effect changed to -3(2) max HP after each battle.[/p][/*][*][p]Clumsy Toe: Negative effect changed to -1(2) max hand size.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]✨ QoL Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]All buff icons have been redrawn, finally ending the era of identical placeholder icons stacked together.[/p][/*][*][p]Buff icons now appear next to buff names in descriptions, showing their stacks.[/p][/*][*][p]During your turn, playable cards glow. If playing one would increase Sin, they glow black instead.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🐞 Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed [b]Revenge[/b] still resetting cost when played under [b]Murderous Resolve[/b] (was this even a bug?).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed monsters’ minions still acting after their leader was killed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some cards freezing when discarding those with the [i]Instant[/i] keyword.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo 0.8.0 Patch Notes — New Class! The Fracture Arrives!
notes.content: [h3]🌟 New Class: Fracture[/h3][p]The initial version of Fracture is here![/p][p]Currently, he comes with [b]45 cards[/b]. While the number isn’t huge, it’s already enough to test his core mechanics. (In fact, I still have many ideas that didn’t make it in yet!)[/p][p]Balancing such a unique mechanic as the [b]Splitters[/b] is an extraordinary challenge, so I’ll be keeping a close eye on feedback and making adjustments as needed.[/p][p]I can’t wait to see what players think — if you have any feedback, please feel free to reach out![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45325967/5a58dfc54db16a05b352d3e695f447656e8cd177.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3]🩸 Sanguinar’s Starting Deck Adjustment[/h3][p]Previously, the Sanguinar’s starting deck was too bland — not only unfun to play, but it also failed to highlight his unique traits.[/p][p]So, I broke away from the principle of “starting decks should remain simple” and [b]remade 2 of his starting cards[/b]:[/p][list][*][p][b]Stab[/b] → [b]Bloodarrow[/b][/p][list][*][p]Cost: 1[/p][/*][*][p]Deal 4 attack damage.[/p][/*][*][p]Consume all your [b]Bleed[/b], applying the same amount of [b]Armor Break[/b] to the target.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Minor Heal[/b] → [b]Bloodheal[/b][/p][list][*][p]Cost: 1[/p][/*][*][p]Heal 6 [b]Wounded HP[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Gain 2 [b]Bleed[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Instant.[/b] (When this card is discarded, it is automatically played without consuming Power.)[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3]📖 Terminology Update[/h3][p]There are actually [b]two types of healing[/b] in the game:[/p][list][*][p]One restores only [b]Wounded HP[/b],[/p][/*][*][p]The other restores HP directly.[/p][/*][/list][p]Previously, these two effects were easy to confuse. From now on, they will use different terms:[/p][list][*][p]Restoring [b]damaged HP[/b] will be referred to as [b]“Heal.”[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Restoring HP directly will be referred to as [b]“Recover.”[/b][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: ✨ Demo v0.7.8 Update — Monster Animation Polish
notes.content: [p]🎞️ [b]Monster Animation Enhancements[/b][/p][p]Polished monster attack and skill animations.[/p][p]Though limited in resources, I’ve done best to make them [b]more fluid and impactful[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]🖼️ [b]Card Art Updates[/b][/p][p]The following cards have finally received their proper illustrations (goodbye placeholder art!):[/p][list][*][p]Major Heal[/p][/*][*][p]Focus[/p][/*][*][p]Divine Sin[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]📜 [b]Event Option Details[/b][/p][p]When hovering over event options,[/p][p]you’ll now see a [b]tooltip preview of rewards[/b],[/p][p]including the full descriptions of cards or items you’ll receive.[/p][p][/p][p]🎧 [b]Audio Rebalance[/b][/p][p]Combat BGM has been rebalanced,[/p][p]it should sound [b]less harsh[/b] now.[/p][p][/p][p]🐞 [b]Bug Fixes & Miscellaneous[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed localization loading issues; added a [b]language selection screen on first launch[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where too many Foul cards [b]blocked draw notifications[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Curse cards are now [b]correctly un-upgradeable[/b][/p][/*][*][p]The [b]“Ctrl to view Explanation”[/b] key now supports macOS (Command key)[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: ✨ Demo v0.7.7 Update —— Resolve Level
notes.content:
[p][b]New Hero Progression System — [i]Resolve Level[/i] Unlocked![/b][/p][p][/p][p]🧠 [b]Earn Echoes to Unlock Cards[/b][/p][p]At the end of each run, the [b]Echoes of Memory[/b] you collect will now also contribute to increasing the [b]Resolve Level[/b] of the hero you played.[/p][p][/p][p]🔓 [b]Leveling up Resolve unlocks new cards for that hero.[/b][/p][p]We’ve chosen to lock certain cards early on — [b]not to restrict player freedom[/b], but to offer gentle progression and onboarding.[/p][p]Some cards are more complex or situational, and may be difficult to utilize early on.
As you level up, you’ll unlock cards with [b]internal synergies[/b] and [b]theme-based mechanics[/b],
encouraging you to explore new builds and playstyles.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45325967/92b31dc11079fcf5f3e9cb599e3ec6174b5b6d42.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p]🃏 [b]Card Adjustments[/b][/p][list][*][p]🧘‍♀️ [b]Focus[/b]: Duration 4 → 5,  Now gains [b]Preemptive[/b] when upgraded[/p][/*][*][p]💭 [b]Traumatic Memory[/b]: Upgrade draw 1 → draw 2[/p][/*][*][p]🕰️ [b]Recall[/b]: Duration 1 → 5[/p][/*][*][p]🔪 [b]Sharpening[/b]: +2/+3 ATK → +3/+4 ATK[/p][/*][*][p]🌿 [b]Crimson Thorn[/b]: Self-Bleed 4(6) → 2(3)[/p][/*][*][p]🤸‍♀️ [b]Roll and Evade[/b]: +3 Agility → +4 Agility[/p][/*][*][p]😖 [b]Pain Emerges[/b]: Manual draw → Auto-draw from [b]random draw pile[/b][/p][/*][*][p]💉 [b]Rapid Recovery[/b]: Upgrade draw 1 → draw 2[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]👹 [b]Enemy Adjustments[/b][/p][p]Lowered HP for the following enemies to ease early game difficulty:[/p][list][*][p]Sailor[/p][/*][*][p]Pirate[/p][/*][*][p]Serpentkin[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo v0.7.0 Update — A Radical Attempt
notes.content:
[p]Welcome back!
This update introduces a [b]bold gameplay change[/b]: a [b]complete rework of the card draw system[/b].[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]🔄 A Brand-New Draw Mechanic[/h3][p]The draw pile is now [b]divided into 4 separate piles[/b] based on card types:[/p][list][*][p][b]Ritual[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Attack[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Skill[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Ability[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]Whenever you draw a card, [b]you can freely choose which pile to draw from[/b], one card at a time.
If a pile runs empty, a [b]reshuffle button[/b] will appear below it — though [b]reshuffling costs 1 draw[/b].[/p][p]This seemingly simple change brings a [b]whole new layer of strategy and experience[/b].[/p][p]
Players now have far more control over how their turns unfold. [/p][p]In fact, it feels like the system [b]forces you to think[/b] and make intentional decisions.[/p][p]During internal testing, I found myself constantly evaluating the situation before every draw — building a sense of anticipation.[/p][p]And as the draw progresses, that anticipation is either fulfilled… or not.[/p][p][/p][p]Of course, the system isn’t without risk:[/p][list][*][p]The [b]learning curve is definitely steeper[/b], and new players may struggle to understand when to draw from which pile.[/p][/*][*][p]And in long runs, constantly choosing which pile to draw from might become [b]a bit tiring[/b].[/p][/*][/list][p]But these are just my predictions.
[b]Your real feedback will be invaluable[/b] in helping me improve this system going forward.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]🛠️ Card Changes (to fit the new draw system)[/h3][p][b]Drawblade[/b][/p][list][*][p]Old: Keep drawing until an Attack is found, discarding all non-Attack cards[/p][/*][*][p]New: [b]Draw 1 card from the Attack pile. That card costs -1 this turn. Exhaust.[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Block Perception[/b][/p][list][*][p]Old: Discard up to 3 cards from the top of the draw pile; heal 5 for each[/p][/*][*][p]New: [b]Discard exactly 2 cards from the top of the draw pile; heal 7 for each[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]⚠️ Some cards are [b]temporarily disabled[/b] because they don’t work well with the new system:[/p][list][*][p][b]Hide the Price[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Twist Fate[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]☠️ Changes to Curse and Torment Cards[/h3][list][*][p]When gained [b]during combat[/b], Curses and Torment cards will now be placed [b]on top of a random draw pile[/b][/p][/*][*][p]The effect “gaining Taint when retained” has been [b]removed[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]So now, [b]you’re free to play, keep, or discard them — entirely your call[/b].[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]That’s everything for this update.
I truly hope you enjoy the new draw system. If anything feels confusing, annoying, or just not right — [b]please do leave your feedback[/b], either here or in-game![/p][p]—[/p][p]If you like the update — or just like the game —
a wishlist, review, or recommending it to a friend would mean [b]the world to me. ❤️[/b][/p]

notes.title: Demo v0.6.7 Major Update Notes
notes.content:
[h3]🎁 Post-Battle Card Rewards[/h3]
After each battle, you'll immediately receive a card reward:
[list]
[*] 3 cards will be shown
[*] Each card can be individually refreshed (max 2 times)
[*] Choose up to 2 cards to add to your deck
[/list]

[h3]🎲 Removal of Randomness[/h3]
[list]
[*] Removed damage variance and critical strike mechanics
[*] Dodge is no longer chance-based
[/list]

[h3]🌀 Dodge Mechanic Overhaul[/h3]
[list]
[*] Dodge now reduces damage equal to your Agility stat
[*] Introduced new Agility buff that interacts with Dodge
[*] Reworked all related cards and monster skills
[/list]

[h3]💉 Monster Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] Removed non-telegraphed healing from monsters — all heals are now visible beforehand
[/list]

[h3]🦠 Parasite Growth System[/h3]
[list]
[*] Mutation system replaced with a Growth mechanic
[*] Progress: +10% every hour
[*] Growth results are now previewable
[/list]

[h3]🔍 Improved Glossary Hints[/h3]
[list]
[*] Items now show keyword explanations for easier understanding
[/list]

[h3]🃏 Initial Hand Size Adjustment[/h3]
[list]
[*] The starting hand size in combat is now capped at 9 cards
[/list]

notes.title: Divine Sin Demo is Now Live — Try It Now!
notes.content:
[h2]A Word from the Developer[/h2]

[i]One year ago, a fool gave up a well-paid job to start making this game alone.
Day after day, he poured a part of his soul into the project.
In the countless moments of pain and joy, there were so many things he wanted to say.
But now, at the very moment the demo is finally released, he finds that no words can truly capture this overwhelming feeling.

So, with that said—
[b]Hope you have fun playing.[/b][/i]


[h2]🎮 Demo Content[/h2]
[list]
[list]
[*] 1 playable hero
[*] 100+ cards
[*] 3 major stage zones (including 40 regular enemies, 6 elites, and 3 bosses)
[/list]
[/list]
[b]The full version will contain roughly 3 to 4 times more content.[/b]


[h2]v0.6.1 Update Notes (compared to v0.5.5)[/h2]

[h3]🎨 Card Art Redraw[/h3]
[list]
[*] All of the Sanguinar’s cards (except for ritual cards) now have official artwork.
[/list]

[h3]🧭 Tutorial Added[/h3]
[list]
[*]A basic rules tutorial has been added. If the game still feels difficult to pick up, feel free to leave feedback!
[/list]

[h3]🃏 Card Balance Adjustments[/h3]

[b]No Regrets[/b]
[list]
[*] Heal 1(2) → Heal 2(3)
[/list]
[b]Phantom Clone[/b]
[list]
[*] Now includes Deplete
[*] Upgrade no longer reduces cost, but removes Deplete
[/list]
[b]Blood for Blood[/b]
[list]
[*] Cost 2 → 1
[*] Now includes Deplete
[*] Upgrade no longer reduces cost, but removes Deplete
[/list]
[b]Crazy Slash[/b]
[list]
[*] Damage 7~14 (10~20) → 7~9 (10~12)
[/list]
[b]Harvest+[/b]
[list]
[*] Apply 8 Bleeding → Apply 6 Bleeding 
[/list]

[b]Blood Echo[/b]
[list]
[*] Card type changed from Skill → Ability
[/list]

[b]Quick Slash+[/b]
[list]
[*] Upgrade no longer increases draw, now increases damage
[*] Damage 8~10, Draw 2 → Damage 12~14, Draw 1
[/list]

[h3]🐞 Known Bugs[/h3]
[list]
[*] The boss Giant King in Area 3 sometimes incorrectly gains attack power every time it takes damage. Cause unknown.
[*] Switching languages repeatedly may cause text display issues. Restarting the game will fix it.
[/list]
[b]Apologies to players who encounter any bugs.
If you discover new ones, you're welcome to report them directly in-game.[/b]

notes.title: Playtest v0.5.5 Update
notes.content:
[h2]✨ New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Card Compendium[/b]: View all discovered cards
[*] [b]Item Encyclopedia[/b]: Browse all discovered items
[*] [b]Card Details[/b]: Right-click a card to view detailed info and upgrade effects
[/list]

[h2]🧬 Parasite System Adjustment[/h2]
[b]Parasite Mutation Chance Updated[/b]
[list]
[*] Mutation chance starts at 0% when obtained
[*] Increases by +1% per hour
[/list]

[h2]👹 Monster Adjustment[/h2]
[b]Giant King[/b]
[list]
[*] HP reduced: 1200 → 1000
[/list]

notes.title: Playtest v0.33 Version Update
notes.content:
[b]Bug fixes[/b]

Some English localizations of tips are missing

Stella will still remove pollution when she refuses to remove pollution

When using the Forgotten Book, will discard additional cards

notes.title: Playtest v0.32 Version Update
notes.content:
[b]v0.32 Balance adjustment[/b]

Changed the rarity of the Replacement ritual to rare

Increased the health of the Lurker from 48~54 to 75~90

Increased the health of the Soul Scholar from 130~150 to 150~170

Increased the health of the Soul Snake Coffin from 110~120 to 130~140

The initial soul changed from 50 Pure + 50 Filth to 100 Pure + 0 Filth


[b]v0.32 Bug fixes[/b]

When deducting the upper limit of health, the current health is not deducted

The ritual card played by the Replacement ritual is invisible

You can still draw cards when ending the action, which will cause the wrong discard

Some buttons and prompts are missing English localization

When the Forgotten Book is used, the process of playing cards will be stuck when choosing to discard cards at the beginning of the round
